context: Lint-time only; do not block create. Parse each rung command with shlex; report parse failures and placeholder shapes (e.g. the whole command wrapped in <...>, or no token resolvable as a command word). Keep it heuristic and conservative: piped, multi-line, env-var-prefixed, and compound commands are legitimate and must not be flagged.
description: Successor of todo-lint-unrunnable-verification-commands (dropped 2026-07-31). The predecessor had two of the defect classes it was itself meant to catch: (1) its rung invoked `uv run -- python _project/scripts/todo_db.py lint ...`, which runs in the ROOT project venv where libsql is not installed, so against the hosted backend it exits 1 with 'hosted tracker requires the libsql package' before AND after any fix - unrunnable, hence vacuously 'failing'; (2) its w2 promised tests but only_modify omitted tests/unit/scripts/test_todo_db_v2.py, so the work could not land in scope. Premise (re-validated 2026-07-31 against the hosted DB via the blessed wrapper): the done item ducklake-beta-scale-runs-four-modes carries the rung command '<record the four run ids and correctness-gate outcomes on this item>' - angle-bracket prose, not a runnable command - and `todo lint` reports 0 findings on it. lint must report verification commands that cannot execute: commands that fail a shell parse, or are prose placeholders (leading '<', no plausible executable token). This check is the brokenness-rejection that todo-lint-rung-falsifiability-and-scope-completeness-2 depends on: without it, 'rung must fail on the unfixed tree' is vacuously satisfiable by a rung that is merely broken.

preserves.behavior: Existing lint findings keep firing unchanged
Legitimate multi-line or piped verification commands still pass

verifications.command: _project/scripts/todo lint ducklake-beta-scale-runs-four-modes | grep -qi 'record the four run ids'
